map.训练周计划强度分布是做什么的？: What does 80/20 Polarized Training Week Planner do?
map.如何使用训练周计划强度分布？: How do I use 80/20 Polarized Training Week Planner?
map.训练周计划强度分布适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is 80/20 Polarized Training Week Planner best for?
map.按 80/20 极化训练原则，将周训练总量分配为低强度与高强度，生成逐日训练安排: A weekly training-intensity distributor following the 80/20 polarized-training principle: allocate weekly training volume into low- and high-intensity and generate a daily plan.
map.力量周期化：总训练量按高强度 20% / 低强度 80% 分配；高强度日数按周训: Strength periodization: total training volume is split 20% high-intensity / 80% low-intensity; the number of high-intensity days ranges from 1 to 3 per weekly training days (no more than 3, spread apart).
map.💡 极化训练：80% 低强度（有氧基础）+ 20% 高强度（阈值/VO2max）: 💡 Polarized training: 80% low intensity (aerobic base) + 20% high intensity (threshold/VO2max); spread high-intensity days apart and pair them with low-intensity or rest days
map.80/20 极化训练被多数耐力精英运动员采用，兼顾有氧基础与高强度刺激: 80/20 polarized training is used by most elite endurance athletes, balancing an aerobic base with high-intensity stimulus
map.高强度日建议间隔安排（如周二、周四、周六），避免连续高强度: Spread high-intensity days apart (e.g. Tue, Thu, Sat) to avoid consecutive high-intensity sessions
map.低强度指\"可对话\"的轻松区间（Z1-Z2），高强度指阈值及以上（Z4-Z5）: Low intensity means the "conversational" easy zone (Z1-Z2); high intensity means threshold and above (Z4-Z5)
map.初学者高强度占比可降至 15%，随能力提升逐步接近 20%: Beginners can lower the high-intensity share to 15% and gradually approach 20% as fitness improves
map.极化训练：多数低强度+少数高强度。: Polarized training: mostly low intensity plus a little high intensity.
map.备赛按 80% 低强度+20% 高强度分配周量，避免中等强度过多致停滞。: For competition prep, split weekly volume as 80% low intensity + 20% high intensity, avoiding too much moderate intensity that causes stagnation.
map.周训练 80% 低强度（轻松跑）、20% 高强度间歇，提升有氧基底。: Weekly training: 80% low intensity (easy runs), 20% high-intensity intervals, to build the aerobic base.
map.业余也适用？: Does it apply to amateurs too?
map.适用，但可放宽至 70/30。: Yes, but it can be loosened to 70/30.
map.全高强度不行吗？: Can't I just train all high intensity?
map.过度高强度累积疲劳且刺激单调，极化分布兼顾基础与发展上限。: Excessive high intensity accumulates fatigue and gives monotonous stimulus; a polarized distribution balances the base with the ceiling for development.
map.训练周计划强度分布工具，依据 80/20 极化训练原则，将周训练总量按 80%: An 80/20 polarized training week planner: following the 80/20 polarized-training principle, it splits weekly training volume into 80% low intensity and 20% high intensity, automatically determines the number of high-/low-intensity days and the duration per session, and generates a spaced-out daily plan, helping endurance athletes scientifically balance an aerobic base with high-intensity stimulus.
